origin_selection: All archived pilot origins, all prepared stock anchors; never select by realized availability or performance
horizon: First benchmark session on or after the one-year UTC calendar anniversary; all instruments must have both exact endpoints; no asset-specific date shift
outcome: Provider adjusted-close ratio minus one, gross reinvested total-return proxy; not executable cash-dividend wealth or original-vintage certification
forecast: Archived annual anchor, a drift-location parameter, not the simulator's unconditional mean or median terminal return
metrics: mean signed error forecast minus realized
matching: All predictors evaluated on the same scored stock rows within each origin; preserve every exclusion; no pooling CASH or benchmark with stock observations
adjustments: Exclude missing or nonpositive endpoints and any documented non-split price adjustment strictly after origin through the frozen market cut; preserve affected rows
portfolio_context: Report archived CASH decision at its declared zero yield and hypothetical 35% SPY / 65% CASH gross buy-and-hold proxy. No costs, cashflow reconciliation, claim of matched risk or certified strategy backtest
gate_context: Report archived candidate admissibility and positive lower gains separately; archived feasible=false lacks per-model failure attribution, so do not invent a cause or interpret CASH-versus-CASH confirmation as evidence about rejected investments
inference: Two overlapping annual origins, correlated selected stocks: descriptive only; no p-values, confidence intervals, annual risk calibration, economic superiority, or validation declaration
intervals: Anchor low/high are parameter ranges, not predictive quantiles; do not score them as P05/P95
changes: Do not rerun or tune forecasts, dates, seeds, priors, restrictions, weights or kernel; do not rewrite the pilot cohort
